_about: Sound registry. "buses" is the mixer: AudioMix (scripts/audio/audio_mix.gd) builds these buses at start and each one gets a volume slider under Settings > Audio (the setting key is audio.<bus id>). "entries" are sounds, one each (lane B4 fills them): {"files": ["res://assets/audio/..."], "bus": "weapons", "volume_db": 0, "pitch_jitter": 0.05, "max_distance_m": 400, "attenuation": "inverse_square"}. "weapons" and "surfaces" say which sound a weapon or a surface makes. Sfx.play("<entry>", where) plays one (scripts/audio/sfx.gd). Candidates under review live in assets/audio/review/ with its listening page.

weapons._about: Which sounds a weapon makes, by weapons.json id (lane B4): fire, reload, casing (a casing landing about 0.6 s after the shot, where it falls).

surfaces._about: Impact and footstep sounds per surface (lane B4). A hit or a foot on a moving body (a mech) is metal; on a kit piece (walls, rubble, rocks) rock; on the terrain dirt.

reverbs._about: Reverb characters for reverb zones (lane B4). The Effects bus has one reverb; while the listener is inside a map's reverb zone (maps.json reverb_zones) it blends toward that zone's entry, wet scaled by the zone's amount. Fields: room_size, damping, spread, wet, predelay_ms, predelay_feedback, hipass (AudioEffectReverb).

shell_hits._about: Lane B4 part 2: what a landing round sounds like by its projectile mass (Projectile 'impacted' info projectile_kg). The first rule whose min_kg it reaches plays its sound with a quieter surface sound under it; lighter rounds play only the surface sound. A 57 mm shell (1.2-2.7 kg) bangs instead of ringing.
